verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents several in-product AI features that produce insights and suggestions from the user's own ledger. AI Close uses agents to review transactions and surface discrepancies. An "ask AI" button suggests transaction categorizations. Accounting AI runs prompts on the general ledger, and cash runway forecasts run as an AI task alongside the Dashboard. The MCP route to Claude is extra but sits outside the product. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the in-product insights are useful, and in-depth docs for the in-product plain-English Q&A (only a marketing line).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction —without context switching between tools.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger. The output reflects your existing accounts and categories.
Ask anything about your business, instantly, in plain English.
You can see runway on the Dashboard, run a forecast as an AI task, or ask Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant through the Puzzle MCP.
